method.cue: Compare two pitch distributions across both ends of 0.80 s candidates on an 80 ms grid. Each endpoint uses two 140 ms regions and a 20 ms guard. Require concurrent series in both regions. Score movement of the quieter series only when the stronger series stays relatively continuous.
method.gate: At -5 dB gain at least two useful primary localizations above the incumbent at no more than one added ordinary flag and no background-only flag. Transfer requires at least two of six at both -5 and -10 dB with at most one ordinary flag each. Useful means at least half of the true edit covered and at least .30 temporal IoU.
method.input: Only the 16 kHz mono submitted waveform. Peak-safe same-word replacements in retained AMI mixtures. Earlier copies, known levels, truths and model scores cannot enter candidate inference.
method.operating_point: Use the maximum candidate score on the 38 ordinary/background primary development deliveries, including all noise levels and dry. Use a strict point. Seal development and the point before scoring held inputs. Compare the previously frozen incumbent and background-reduced points on identical primary inputs.
method.pitch: A 64 ms Hann FFT advances 20 ms. Subtract a smoothed log magnitude. Seek two distinct harmonic series, with the second series supported at least 26 Hz from bins of the strongest series. Require at least five supporting partials, each at least 2.5 percent of the peak magnitude between 250 and 3600 Hz, and reject octave/subharmonic overlap.
method.scope: Primary assessment reuses the earlier primary bank with two held reader groups; transfer uses three other held readers and two other AMI sessions from the clean-reference study. Their other-method outcomes were known. Count ordinary waveform replacements as genuine for synthetic detection, together with unchanged, gain, genuine resampling, EQ and isolated background.
